title: Webhooks
subtitle: Push lead, card scan and order events to your own systems as they happen. Every delivery is signed with HMAC-SHA256; failed deliveries are retried.
empty.title: No webhooks yet
empty.description: Add an HTTPS address and pick the events you want to receive.
confirm_delete.title: Delete this webhook?
confirm_delete.description: {{url}} will stop receiving events. The delivery log is kept for 30 days.
confirm_rotate.title: Rotate the secret?
confirm_rotate.description: A receiver still verifying with the old secret will reject new deliveries. The new secret is shown only once.
dialog.description: Events are POSTed as JSON to the address you choose. The receiver must answer 2xx within 10 seconds.
fields.url_hint: Must be a public HTTPS address; local network and private IP addresses are refused.
fields.is_active_hint: An inactive endpoint receives no events.
secret.title: Your signing secret
secret.description: This secret is shown only now. Store it on your receiver to verify signatures; rotate it if you lose it.
secret.how: Signature: the X-ComCode-Signature header is t=<unix time>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "t.body")>.
deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: Events sent to {{url}}. Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times with growing delays.
deliveries.empty_description: They appear when the first subscribed event arrives. Send a test to try it now.
